citations.assessment: The destination’s heading has ben Yose and expressly discusses Ashyan among the possibilities. Preserve this root’s bar form.
The Yasin entry links back to Ashyan and separately distinguishes the Yose ben Yose parallel in Jerusalem Berakhot.
